_comment: MCP servers attached to the Claude engineering lane, and only that lane.
The analysis and advance lanes run with --safe-mode, which disables every
MCP server regardless of this file.
Bearer values are written as ${VAR} and expanded by Claude Code from the
orchestrator's environment at connect time, so no token is stored in this
file or in the child's argv. The launcher loads them from the Keychain.
The orchestrator passes --strict-mcp-config, so these are the only MCP
servers reachable no matter what ~/.claude.json contains.
